parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` within the `Artwork` package. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.714 indicates structural overlap, the two methods — `fetchesCachedArtworkWithoutReleaseTitle` (line 593) and `skipsEmptyReleaseTitle` (line 649) — encode distinct test scenarios (cached artwork without a release title vs. skipping an empty release title) whose near-identical shape is a natural consequence of the arrange-act-assert test pattern rather than unintentional duplication. Collapsing them into a shared helper would obscure the intent of each individual test case.
